instruction: A candid wide-angle documentary photograph in a motion capture studio with a red carpet. On the left, the bearded man in a black t-shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing forward-right. On the right, the woman in a white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) leans forward, extending her right hand to touch the man's chest while her left leg is raised slightly behind her. The background features white walls, a radiator, and bright overhead lighting.
elements: R2 extends her right hand to touch R1's chest
R1 receives the chest touch from R2 rather than initiating it
R2 leans forward toward R1 while making the chest contact
R2 has her left leg raised slightly behind her during the interaction
The interaction takes place in a motion capture studio with a red carpet
